newsitem.title: UK: Celsis says forms hygiene monitor alliance.
newsitem.headline: Celsis says forms hygiene monitor alliance.

text.p: Celsis International Plc said on Thursday it had entered into a three year distribution and co-marketing agreement with Diversey for systemSURETM, its portable hygiene monitoring system, in the U.S.
The deal is an extension of the company's alliance wth Lever Industrial in Europe and is expected to result in up to 500 systems being placed in the U.S. over the next 12 months.
Both alliances focus on the food and beverage sector.
SystemSURETM is a portable instrument that enables levels of microbial contamination on the surfaces of processing plant and machinery to be monitored.
"Diversey will benefit from Lever's experience in Europe during the last 12 months and be able to fast-track the introduction of the system into the U.S.," said Celsis chief executive Arthur Holden.
Diversey is an integral part of DiverseyLever, the global market leader in the provision of cleaning products and services for industrial and institutional customers.
